text:
Heather's Live Painting was the perfect unique touch to our wedding day and it made for such great "Atmosphere Entertainment" for the guests! Our guests fell in love watching Heather, and loved seeing the details she continued to add throughout the event. 
From our first consultation, with Heather, to the delivery, she was everything we could have asked for and more. I had no idea what moment I wanted Heather to paint, how I wanted the painting to look, etc. After talking through details, Heather made quick sketches during the phone consultation and texted her sketches to me and my husband to view. It was so neat how she was helping us visualize the painting in advance with these sketches. A TRUE talent! 
Heather captured our first dance, and the painting came out absolutely beautiful, and it is hanging front and center in our home. We had Heather ship our painting, and I want to add, that my husband and I appreciated that she even thought to add the hanging material to the back of the painting. It's all about the details with Heather!
Highly recommend Heather for your event. Having this painting in our home is something we will cherish for the rest of our lives, and we love reliving our first dance moment through this painting everyday.

Thank you so much Heather!

owner_reply.text: Rachele, this brings be so much joy that you loved your experience and painting so much!! I am so honored to have painted at your wedding. Thank you very much for having me!

text:
Heather was the absolute BEST!! Her attention to detail blew our mind. Not only
was our painting an excellent rendition of the photo she captured, but she even captured the time in my husband’s watch, of when we actually said “I Do”.  Real feathers and beads are in the painting and with our wedding being on a yacht, she used actual water from the dock, for her paint. Every single guest was blown away by this surprise and my husband was, as well. It fits so beautifully in our home!! Definitely my favorite takeaway from Our Big Day.

owner_reply.text: Ciera your wedding was unbelievably gorgeous and I had such a wonderful time painting the night away as we cruise by the Miami skyline. I must say that was a first for me! I will always remember this special painting and how much fun I had! Thank you for letting me be apart of you wedding and encouraged me to let my creative mind flow without limitations. This painting is one of my favorites!!

text: I am so happy I found Heather! I really wanted a live wedding painter for my reception but I also wanted to ensure I found someone whose style I really loved. After hours of searching I found Heather's website and fell in love with her work. There were wedding painters closer to me in SC but I knew I would be happy with whatever Heather produced so the extra travel fees (outside of her normal area) were definitely worth it to me. She did not disappoint. The end product was amazing and I couldn't be happier. The live wedding painting experience also was very entertaining for my guests. It was amazing to see the painting progress throughout the reception. I would happily give Heather more than 5 stars if I could!

text: We booked Heather for a live wedding painting, and she was absolutely one of our favorite wedding vendors! She is SO talented, easy to work with, responsive, and you will be blown away with the painting.  We had a couple of ideas and Heather incorporated them all into our painting, and the level of detail far exceeded our expectations.  If you’re even remotely considering a wedding painter, I’d recommend Heather a million times over. Oh and, our guests loved watching her during our reception too!

owner_reply.text: Emily, thank you so much for having me be a part of your wedding. It was an honor! Your wedding was truly breathtaking!
